correctness.rationale: For k>=8 and n=3k-2, disjoint/intersection-one/other intersection cases give exact distances 1/3/2. Johnson harmonic eigenvalues are obtained by explicit signed-pair counting. The normalized nonconstant spectrum is a_j[r_j((3/2)^p-1)-(1-2^{-p})]-1. Convex monotonicity gives a unique j=2 crossing; explicit inequalities show every odd harmonic <= -1/4 and all even j>=4 are strictly negative throughout the allowed exponent interval. The endpoint multiplicity and central-binomial asymptotic follow. The included independent graph-distance/orbital-action checker and exact inequality checks passed. Finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

limitations: Only n=3k-2 with integer k>=8 is proved.
Endpoint equivalence uses squared Euclidean distances d^p.
Literature checks are bounded; priority and independent mathematical validation remain unconfirmed.

value.rationale: Theorem computes a natural generalized-roundness invariant across a canonical infinite family of diameter-three Kneser metrics. It proves a uniform unique extremal harmonic, exact Hilbert squared-distance embedding dimension at equality, and an exponentially decaying critical exponent even though graph diameter is fixed. These are structural facts beyond a local spectrum or arbitrary finite table.
